labels.accounting: Cesium's own CPU-side accounting of uploaded texture bytes, BASE LEVELS ONLY. Not a driver query.
labels.mipChain: A full mip pyramid adds roughly 1.3333333333333333x on top of the base level; that is stated, never measured here.
labels.wireVersusGpu: A tile is 16580 PNG bytes on the wire and 65536 bytes as an RGBA base level.
labels.export: ResourceCache.statistics is a Cesium-internal export, pinned at the installed version; a version bump invalidates this reading rather than adjusting it.
